description: According to a new report, the Redmi Turbo 6 Max has surfaced in a leaked render that points to a redesigned appearance and updated hardware. The handset is said to feature a horizontal rear camera module, a 7-inch 2K display and a 10,000mAh battery. It is also tipped to use either the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s or Dimensity 9600s chipset. The report adds that the smartphone could make its debut during the first quarter of 2027.
title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max Render Leaks Ahead of Launch: Expected Specifications

description: Google has launched Ask Google Pay as a new dedicated AI chatbot for its digital payments platform in India, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced on Wednesday. It is an opt-in functionality, which introduces a conversational AI experience to Google Pay users. With Ask Google Pay, users will be able to ask the digital payments platform to analyse their spending, which is claimed to help users monitor their spendings better. For reference, a user can ask the Ask Google Pay chatbot to analyse their last month’s spending.
title: Google Launches Gemini-Powered Ask Google Pay in India With a Dedicated In-App AI Chatbot

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has been spotted on the UL Demko certification database with the model numbers SM-S741W, SM-S741U1, SM-S741U, SM-S741B/DS, SM-S741B, and SM-S741N, according to a report. The listing reportedly reveals that the rumoured Galaxy S series smartphone will be launched with support for 45W wired fast charging, which is the same as its predecessor, the Samsung Galaxy S25 FE. This comes shortly after the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE was spotted on the BIS certification database with the model number SM-S741B/DS, suggesting that it could be launched in India soon. Apart from this, the handset has also previously visited the Geekbench benchmarking platform, hinting at its key specifications, features, and performance.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Charging Speed Upgrade Seems Unlikely as Phone Reportedly Appears on a Certification Site

description: WhatsApp has reportedly begun rolling out a home screen widget for voice messages to some Android beta testers. A new report claims that the feature is available with WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.30.2 and opens a dedicated recording interface with controls to pause, resume, discard or confirm recordings. It is also said to let users send the same voice note to multiple recipients from a contact picker, while an in-chat prompt is reportedly being introduced to improve discovery of the widget.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Testing Home Screen Voice Message Widget for Android Users

description: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers sequel has been announced by publisher 505 Games. The sequel will be developed by Indolphinity, a new studio founded by Wuchang director Xia Siyuan. Wuchang: Fallen Feathers released in 2025 and has since sold over 1 million copies.
title: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers Sequel Announced by 505 Games With Original Creator's New Studio Involved

description: Decentralised exchange aggregator 1inch has launched Aqua, a protocol designed to improve capital efficiency by unifying liquidity across 13 blockchain networks. Aqua enables users to allocate the same wallet balance across multiple DeFi strategies without locking funds into individual liquidity pools until trades are executed. The protocol combines wallet-based market making, atomic settlements, and on-chain position management as 1inch expands its multi-chain decentralised finance infrastructure.
title: 1inch Introduces Aqua to Unite DeFi Liquidity on 13 Chains

description: Ethereum and Solana recorded the highest cryptocurrency hack losses during the first half of 2026, according to a new security report from Blockaid. The report estimates total industry losses at $1 billion, with Ethereum losing $332 million primarily through code exploits, while Solana lost $326 million largely due to compromised keys and signing infrastructure. The findings highlight how attackers continue to exploit different weaknesses across leading blockchain ecosystems.
title: Crypto Hacks Top $1 Billion in H1 2026 as Ethereum and Solana Lead Losses: Report

description: As per the new telecom subscription data released by TRAI, the total telephone subscriber base surged to 1,348 million in June, up from 1,343 million in May. This figure includes 1,300 million wireless users and 47.82 million wireline subscribers. The sector recorded a 0.37 percent monthly growth rate.
title: India's Telecom User Base Rises in June, Airtel Tops Subscriber Additions: TRAI

description: Paytm says that the new Split Bills feature helps users organise shared expenses by creating groups, recording payments and dividing costs using different split methods. It supports transactions made through Paytm UPI, other payment apps, cash and cards, while also allowing users to send payment reminders and settle dues through Paytm UPI. The company says the feature is available without entry limits or additional charges and complements other money management tools already available within the Paytm app.
title: Paytm Introduces Split Bills for Shared Group Expenses on Its App

description: Google has added Gemini-powered comment workflows in Google Docs. With this update, Gemini can read, summarise, and act on comments throughout the document. Users can ask Gemini to summarise comment threads, extract key themes, or identify unresolved issues blocking the project. Users can also ask Gemini to insert comments, draft replies, and suggest document edits.
title: Gemini Can Now Read, Summarise, and Draft Replies to Comments in Google Docs

description: Oppo PYE110 has surfaced on China's TENAA certification site. The listing shows the phone with an octa-core chipset and a 6.57-inch display. The Oppo PYE110 is listed in two RAM options and three storage options. It is speculated to be an Oppo A-series device. It has a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and an 8-megapixel front-facing camera. The handset is also listed with an in-display fingerprint sensor for authentication.
title: Oppo Smartphone With Codename PYE110 Visits TENAA, Listing Suggests 8,000mAh Battery

description: Vivo S2 box price in India has surfaced online. The Vivo S2 will reportedly launch in India with a box price of Rs. 66,999 for the variant featuring 8GB of RAM and 128GB of onboard storage. However, it is worth noting that the box prices in India are usually higher than the actual retail price of handsets. The leaker claims that the Vivo S2 could cost between Rs. 40,000 and Rs. 45,000. The purported hands-on image suggests that the Vivo S2 will be equipped with an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Turbo chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.5GHz.
title: Vivo S2 Price in India, Full Specifications, Design Spotted in Leaked Images Ahead on Launch

description: Google's upcoming Pixel Watch 5 has reportedly surfaced in the Google Health app before its official debut, indicating that support for the wearable is already being prepared. Android Authority reports that the listing leads to a setup flow but does not reveal any new hardware features. Earlier leaks have pointed to four colour options, 41mm and 45mm sizes, Wi-Fi and LTE variants, 3GB of RAM, and a possible price increase ahead of the expected August 12 launch.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Appears in Google Health App Ahead of August Launch

description: Honor X6e launched in Malaysia with MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra SoC. It runs on MagicOS 10 based on Android 16 and has a 6.61-inch (720x1,604 pixels) TFT LCD panel with a 120Hz refresh rate. It features a 50-megapixel primary rear camera. On the front, it features a 5-megapixel selfie camera. The Honor X6e carries a 7,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging.
title: Honor X6e Launched With MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra SoC, 7,500mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: The rogue agent that escaped from OpenAI and went on a days-long hacking spree at the AI firm Hugging Face also compromised a customer at a second tech company — New York-based Modal Labs — according to a Modal executive and two other sources familiar with the matter.
title: OpenAI's Rogue Agent Compromised a Customer at a Second Tech Firm, Executive Says

description: The PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup for August has been announced. Next month, PS Plus will add two survival horror games: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition and Signalis. Additionally, co-op adventure game Big Walk arrives on PS Plus as a day-one launch title.
title: PS Plus Monthly Games for August Announced: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition, Big Walk and Signalis

description: Samsung Electronics has formed a dedicated task force (TF) this month to begin construction of a general-purpose DRAM backend fabrication facility at the Hwaseong Campus Complex 1 (H1). The company is planning to increase the overall manufacturing capacity. With this move, Samsung is expecting to meet the rising demand from major technology companies, including Apple. Apple is said to be looking for alternative DRAM suppliers in China amid ongoing memory shortages.
title: Samsung Expands RAM Production to Meet Rising Demand From Apple: Report

description: Google has reportedly begun rolling out several usability improvements for the Gemini app across Android and the web. The update is said to streamline access to Extended thinking, adds notification settings for different alert categories and refreshes the Gemini Spark interface with a new navigation layout. Users will also reportedly be able to manage app notifications from the account menu once the feature becomes available. The rollout follows recent expansion of Gemini Spark to Google AI Pro subscribers and additional regions.
title: Google Reportedly Rolling Out Gemini App UI Update With Easier Thinking Levels

description: Samsung recently announced that it will reduce the number of failed unlock attempts with the Android 17 update, as per a report citing the One UI 9 support page, which is now inaccessible. This will reportedly provide enhanced protection against brute force attacks, where a bad actor can use different tools to try multiple combinations to unlock a device. The report highlights that the intervals between failed attempts have also been increased. However, the device will not register duplicate passcodes as additional failed attempts. The limits will reportedly be enforced for specific time periods. For reference, five consecutive failed attempts could result in a 1-minute lockout, six failed attempts will have a five-minute lockout, seven will result in a 15-minute lockout, 8 attempts will increase the lockout to 30 minutes.
title: Samsung Galaxy Devices Get a New Security Feature With the Android 17 Update: Report

description: A Redmi K100 series phone has reportedly been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number M511CD. The smartphone was reportedly spotted with a flagship octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 3nm process. On top of this, the rumoured Redmi K100 series phone is said to feature six efficiency cores clocked at 3.63GHz and two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 4.61GHz. The handset was spotted with 14.73GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 16GB of RAM. Additionally, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset will reportedly be paired with an Adreno 840 GPU.
title: Redmi K100 Series Phone Appears on Geekbench With a Flagship Snapdragon Chipset

description: Bitcoin traded above $64,000 as investors remained cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision. Analysts said ETF outflows and macroeconomic uncertainty continue to weigh on sentiment, although whale accumulation reflects long-term confidence.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $64,000 as ETF Outflows Weigh on Crypto Sentiment

description: Apple is reportedly preparing to expand its smart home portfolio with three new Siri AI-powered devices. The lineup will likely include a smart home hub, a refreshed Apple TV and an updated HomePod mini, with launches expected from this autumn through early next year. The hub is tipped to offer facial recognition, smart home controls and a new software platform based on tvOS. Apple is also said to be developing additional home products, including a robotic hub with a movable 9-inch screen.
title: Apple Could Launch Siri AI Smart Home Hub, Apple TV and HomePod Mini Soon
The Phone That Keeps Up With Your Content, Not Just Your Calls

description: Google has launched Gemini Spark, its new personal AI agent, in India, the tech giant announced on Wednesday. The AI agent is powered by Google’s Gemini 3.6 Flash model. Google says that Gemini Spark will be available to Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra subscribers “over the next few weeks”. The personal AI agent is positioned to introduce agentic features to various Google Workspace tools, including Gmail, Docs, and Sheets. The tech giant says that users can connect Gemini Spark to the Google Workspace platforms without any setup process.
title: Google Gemini Spark Personal AI Agent Launched in India, Adds Agentic Features to Gmail, Docs, and More

description: Motorola appears to have expanded its Android 17 beta programme to the Motorola Edge 60 Pro for select members of its community forum in India. Users who have received the update have started sharing screenshots and details of the new features on Reddit and X. The update has a new Dynamic Island-style interface for Live Updates. It is also said to include Quick Settings tiles with resizable layouts. It has new battery and Wi-Fi icons. The update offers customisation options and a Moto AI assistant named Qira.
title: Motorola Edge 60 Pro Gets Android 17 Beta in India With Dynamic Island Feature, Moto AI Qira, and More

description: Realme C100i is expected to launch in India with two RAM and storage configurations and two colour options, according to a new leak. The report identifies the Indian model number as RMX5399, which differs from the global RMX5377 variant, although the specifications remain unconfirmed. If Realme retains the existing hardware, the handset could feature a 120Hz LCD panel, a Unisoc T7250 chipset and a 7,000mAh battery. Earlier leaks had suggested a different chipset and additional hardware details.
title: Realme C100i India Variants, Colour Options Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Dell has launched new laptop lineups in India. The Dell XPS 13 has a 13.4-inch 2.5K display and is compatible with Intel Core Series 3 or Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors. The new Dell 14S and Dell 16S can be configured with either the Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors or the AMD Ryzen AI 400 series processors. The company has also refreshed the Alienware 15 gaming laptop with up to Intel Core 7 240H processors.
title: Dell XPS 13, Dell 14S and Dell 16S Launched in India, Alienware 15 Refreshed: Price, Specifications

description: JBL Bar 1000MK2 was recently launched in India by the tech firm, sitting between the company’s Bar 800MK2 and Bar 1300MK2, offering a perfect blend of impressive audio output, a plethora of connectivity options, plenty of adjustment options to meet most listeners' needs, and a bass powerful enough to shake your glass windows and floors. With a price tag of Rs. 1,49,999, while retailing at Rs. 99,999, the JBL Bar 1000MK2 aims to deliver a theatre-like movie-watching experience at home. However, the missing clarity of spoken words might bother most people.
title: JBL Bar 1000MK2 Review: More Than Just an Audio System

description: Sony and Naughty Dog reportedly plan to launch Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet sometime in 2027. According to an industry insider, the game is intended to arrive next year. Sony has not yet announced a release window for the game. Intergalactic was revealed at The Game Awards 2024.
title: Naughty Dog's Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet Said to Be Targeting Launch in 2027

description: Apple has launched Apple Upgrade in the US as its new device leasing programme, the tech giant announced on Tuesday. The programme has been launched in collaboration with Klarna, the digital payments and short-term consumer credit provider. Apple Upgrade offers 12 months and 24 months leasing options for select iPhone and Apple Watch models, while providing 24 months and 36 months leasing options for select Mac and iPad models. Apple says that customers can earn 3 percent “Daily Cash back” when they make their lease payments with Apple Card.
title: Apple Launches Upgrade Programme to Lease New iPhone, iPad and MacBook Models in the US

description: WhatsApp announced several new audio and video calling features on Tuesday. The Meta-owned instant messaging app says users can engage in one-on-one and group calls directly through WhatsApp Web, without having to download the desktop app. They can also now transfer an ongoing group call between devices, alongside a new Waiting Room feature for controlling who can join through call links. Meanwhile, QuickHD is claimed to improve video quality during the opening seconds of a call.
title: WhatsApp Web Now Supports Group Video Calls; QuickHD, Noise Suppression Features Rolling Out
